units.source_text: 我本来就打算近期采访这位吴清源六段，

en.t: I had already been planning to interview this sixth-dan Wu Qingyuan sometime soon,

units.source_text: 在仔细观察这盘告别赛以后，我更想去看看吴清源六段解说这盘棋的情况。

en.t: but after carefully observing this farewell match, I wanted even more to go and see how Wu Qingyuan, sixth dan, explained the game.

units.source_text: 我觉得这也是观战记的一种补遗。

en.t: I felt that this, too, would serve as a kind of supplement to the match record.
